entities.name: Fire Hydrant
entities.rationale: Pink fire hydrant drawing at the left of the board; smart IoT hydrant that records acoustic signals from the pipe network. Not inside any box or container.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: Purple icon labelled 'API GATEWAY' (AWS_Icon_4). Receives daily files from hydrants and provides authentication/security. Not inside any container.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labelled 'S3' (AWS_Icon_5). Persists the acoustic files pushed through API Gateway. Not inside any container.

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: Orange icon labelled 'ECS' (AWS_Icon_2). Daily batch microservices that process node-pair files to find correlations and persistent correlations. Not inside any container.

entities.name: SageMaker
entities.rationale: Teal icon labelled 'SAGEMAKER' (AWS_Icon_1). ML endpoint that assigns a leak probability to persistent correlations. Not inside any container.

entities.name: Analyst
entities.rationale: Pink person figure labelled 'ANALYST' at the upper right (AWS_Icon_3 and AWS_Icon_6). Human analyst who receives the leak score and further classifies the leak. Not inside any container; no line is drawn to it on the board.

visual_connections.description: Curved green arrow from the hydrant up to the top of API Gateway; correlated acoustic files are pushed daily through API Gateway.
Curved green arrow arcing from the top of API Gateway to the top of S3; files are persisted in S3.
Curved green arrow from below S3 down to the left side of ECS; daily batch process in ECS processes the files.
Curved green arrow arcing from the top of ECS to the top of SageMaker; persistent correlations are classified by the SageMaker ML endpoint.
